subtopic: Blamed for something I did not do
passage:
"Mummy, Ma'am said I broke Vihaan's compass, but I never touched it."
"Sit down, Ojas. Take a breath. What happened?"
"My face went hot. I shouted, and she said I was being rude."
"Did you see who did?"
"It was on the front bench. I was in the library the whole period, and Ruchi saw me."
"Then tomorrow we will talk to your teacher together, calmly, with those facts."
"Will she believe me?"
"I do not know. But she should give you a fair hearing."
"Okay. I will not shout this time."
Trisha squeezed his hand.

qa.q: Where was Ojas during the period the compass broke?
qa.a: He was in the library the whole period.

qa.q: Why did Ojas's face go hot?
qa.a: He felt the unfairness of being blamed for something he had not done, and it made him shout.

qa.q: What could Ojas do tomorrow to get a fair hearing?
qa.a: He can explain calmly with facts, such as that he was in the library and Ruchi saw him, and let his mother come along.

qa.q: How might the teacher have seen the shouting?
qa.a: The teacher may have seen it as rudeness and taken it as a sign of guilt, so staying calm and giving facts could change her view.

grounding: A child blamed by his teacher for something he did not do tells his mother, and plans to explain calmly with facts and a fair hearing.
